The '''rings of Geonosis''' were a set of [[Planetary ring/Legends|planetary rings]], composed of [[Meteorite/Legends|meteors]] and rock-and-[[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="Boba Fett" />
